predict.question: One person posts a claim at round 0. Each round, everyone who just got it forwards it to two people who haven't. After three rounds, counting the poster and capped at 12, how many have it?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Influence discusses using other people’s behavior as a guide to choice.
modelBoundary: One-recipient forwarding reaches {A}; two-recipient forwarding {B}. Extra branches multiply copies, while the original source remains one.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Reach is not independent evidence or a measured persuasion effect.
